messages:
maria: Heads up — onboarding Monarch LoRA for customer Aalto showed a truncation/stop after quantizing to int4. Repro below.

maria: ```
# reproduce
python tools/smoke_eval.py --model monarch-lora-v2 --quant int4 --prompt "Summarize invoice 12345"
# observed: output stops after "Total:"
```

aj: @maria thanks. Can you run the quick-eval checklist? Short commands:

aj: ```
# int8 fallback
python tools/smoke_eval.py --model monarch-lora-v2 --quant int8 --prompt-file samples/short_invoices.json
# disable kv cache
python tools/smoke_eval.py --model monarch-lora-v2 --quant int4 --kv_cache=false
```

quentin: I ran 50 samples on a small A10G spot. int4 shows ~8% token drop vs fp16. BLEU -0.12, ROUGE-L -0.04. Two prompts truncate consistently after currency line. My notes: tokenizer subtle byte-split at "$0.00" may be amplifying quant error.

maria: good catch, @quentin. Can you paste the two failing prompts? Also trying a symmetric quant table tweak: `quant_clip=0.98`.

quentin: failing prompts:

quentin: "Invoice 12345\nItems:\n1x Widget — $19.99\nSubtotal: $19.99\nTax: $1.60\nTotal: $21.59\n"

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled to internal-canary (dedicated) for test-run 1713010200 :rocket:

eval-bot: smokepack finished — summary below:

eval-bot: PASS: tokenization parity (30/32)

eval-bot: Suggestion: pin customer Aalto to monarch-lora-v2-int8 or enable prefix caching with int4-safe kernel. cc @devex

maria: I'll open a rollback+hotfix PR for quant config. Thanks everyone :heart:
